name: std::indirectly_comparable

declarations.code:
template <class I1, class I2, class Comp,

    class Proj1 = std::identity, class Proj2 = std::identity>

concept indirectly_comparable =

    std::indirect_binary_predicate<Comp, std::projected<I1, Proj1>,
        std::projected<I2, Proj2>>;

intro: The concept indirectly_comparable specifies the fundamental algorithm requirement for comparing values across two independent ranges.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
sections.text: indirectly_comparable is modeled only if all concepts it subsumes are modeled.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies indirectly_comparable.

summary: The concept indirectly_comparable specifies the fundamental algorithm requirement for comparing values across two independent ranges.
